image_description: A medium shot of a groom and bride in a wedding setting. The groom, on the left, wears a black suit with a white shirt and striped tie. He has short dark hair and a slight smile. The bride, on the right, wears a white strapless wedding dress and veil, smiling gently. A third person's arm and hand are visible on the far right, adjusting the bride's hair or veil. The background includes a window, some hanging decorations (possibly red lanterns or flowers), and indoor lighting.

Slight smudging or softening of skin texture compared to forehead and nose; may indicate minor generative blur or inconsistent detail rendering.

artifact_observations.location: Bride’s veil merging with her hair and shoulder
artifact_observations.reasoning: Veil edges lack sharp boundary where they contact hair and shoulder; appears to ‘melt’ into skin tone rather than overlay cleanly.

selected_experts.reason: Primary class verification: confirm subject matches 'groom' taxonomy with high precision.
Audit human limb structure and posture correctness; critical for detecting hidden anatomical errors in arms/hands.
Verify veil-to-hair and veil-to-shoulder boundaries for fusion artifacts; also check dress continuity.
Assess depth consistency of window, decorations, and foreground subjects to detect perspective collapse.
Holistic quality scan for subtle degradations, especially around facial textures and accessory details.
Locate and segment the anomalous arm/hand region to provide BBox prior for topology audit.

Boundary clarity between veil, hair, and skin
Presence/absence of groom accessories (boutonniere, ring, cufflinks)
Texture consistency on groom’s face and suit fabric
